request.description: The signed-in lender's published products with their current definitions. Lender context (admin, credit officer, viewer). Each item carries the compiled `definition`, the raw `content` of the live version (send an edited copy to propose a change), the product `name` and `pendingVersion` (`{ id, number, status }` while a proposal waits for FundenFlo, otherwise `null`).
